name: ContextAwareGlass

stories.note: Default story passes no children/args; renders an empty surface

material_impl: Wraps OptimizedGlass (primitives/OptimizedGlassCore). All 'adaptation' is mapped to elevation (blur buckets) and intensity (opacity buckets) - but OptimizedGlassCore destructures and discards `intensity` (OptimizedGlassCore.tsx:154,249), so only the 4 elevation buckets do anything. Adds bespoke boxShadow/filter drop-shadow inline; default glowColor '#6366F1' hard-coded.
motion: No animation. useReducedMotion only caps blur and disables drop-shadow glow (ContextAwareGlass.tsx:543,642) - a reduced-motion pref used for a non-motion concern.
a11y: No role/semantics (plain div). Debug overlay uses bg-white/70 text-black etc. 'contrast' mode only nudges opacity buckets; no real contrast measurement.
api: forwardRef with merged ref. Props interface doesn't extend HTMLAttributes so `...rest` is effectively empty (no style passthrough, style is overwritten). 20+ props (min/max blur/opacity, forceLight/Dark) mostly have no visible effect.
ssr: 'use client'. DOM access only in effects/callbacks. Optional setInterval polling (adaptationInterval 1000ms) re-runs querySelectorAll + getComputedStyle.
fake_complexity: High. 'Context-aware' = querySelectorAll counts + parent getComputedStyle backgroundColor parse; computed blur/opacity values then collapse to 4 elevation buckets and a discarded intensity prop. hex parser ignores 3-digit hex; rgba alpha ignored.
target: OptimizedGlass / GlassCard (adaptive contrast belongs in the material primitive)
justification: Not exported from root, duplicates advanced/GlassContextAware, and its core promise is hollow: the adaptation math feeds an `intensity` prop the primitive throws away, so the only output is a choice among 4 elevation classes. The certified screenshot has no ink at all (darkest pixel 228/255): it is an empty pale rectangle on a near-white gradient. If background-adaptive legibility is wanted for 5.0 it should be a real luminance-sampling capability inside the material primitive, not a wrapper.

name: CursorGlow
material_impl: Bespoke: radial-gradient written to element.style.background in rAF, plus filter blur(size/16) saturate() and mix-blend-mode: screen. Builds color as `${color}${toAlpha(opacity)}` - with the default color 'var(--glass-white)' this yields 'var(--glass-white)2e', an invalid CSS value, so the gradient never paints with defaults (CursorGlow.tsx:46,82). Works only for 6-digit hex colors.
motion: rAF-throttled pointermove (good). Reduced motion: listener not attached when reduce && respectMotionPreference (CursorGlow.tsx:74) - correctly wired.
a11y: aria-hidden unless aria-label given; pointer-events none. OK for decoration; role=img with label on a decorative overlay is questionable.
api: forwardRef. Declares intent/elevation/tier props that are not destructured and get spread onto the DOM div (unknown-attribute warnings). In non-global mode it uses clientX/clientY against an absolutely positioned element - offset is wrong whenever the container is not at viewport origin.
ssr: 'use client'; window access in effect only. Fine.
fake_complexity: Low, but default config is broken (invalid color concatenation).
duplicates: OptimizedGlass cursorHighlight flag (OptimizedGlassCore.tsx:266, data attr only)
target: A single pointer-light/specular-highlight primitive in the material system (OptimizedGlass cursorHighlight / LiquidGlass specular)
justification: A pointer-following specular highlight is a legitimate premium-glass ingredient, but this implementation is a full-viewport screen-blended blob, is broken with its own default color, mispositions in local mode, and leaks props to the DOM. It is not root-exported. Fold the idea into the material primitive as a per-surface specular response (local coordinates, token colors, reduced-motion aware) and delete this file.
evidence: reports/glassmorphism-storybook-visual-certification/screenshots/components-interactive-cursorglow/desktop.png (story supplies its own dark gradient; static capture cannot show glow)

name: GlassA11yAuditor
material_impl: OptimizedGlass panels (intensity/blur props passed but discarded by primitive). Raw Tailwind palette classes for status (text-green-400, bg-red-500/10, ring-white/50) mixed with glass-* utilities; injected <style> with hard-coded #ff6b6b/#ff4444 outline.
motion: Motion preset fadeIn wrapper; injected infinite pulse keyframe with no reduced-motion guard; respectMotionPreference prop unused; scrollIntoView smooth unconditionally.
a11y: role='application' on the whole panel (wrong; disables browse mode). Filter buttons lack aria-pressed. Issues list is buttons (good). Score colour-only. Ironically lists 'color-contrast' and 'keyboard-navigation' rules in defaultRules but implements neither.
api: forwardRef but ref goes to inner div while className is applied twice (Motion wrapper and inner). `id || useA11yId()` is a conditional hook call. Audits the entire `document`, not `children`, despite children prop.
ssr: 'use client'; document access only in callbacks. Fine.
fake_complexity: Medium. A real but naive DOM heuristic scanner: focus-visible check inspects non-focused computed outline (meaningless), aria-label rule flags every [role] element, highlight picks the first element of the same tag name rather than the offending node. useA11yAudit only checks img alt. axe-core would do all of this correctly.
target: Docs/devtools package backed by axe-core, not the design-system runtime bundle
justification: A homemade accessibility linter shipped inside a UI kit is a liability: its heuristics produce false positives/negatives, it audits the whole document regardless of children, and it is itself mis-roled (role=application). This is not a visual component a premium design system needs; if kept at all it belongs in a Storybook addon powered by axe-core.

name: GlassAdvancedSearch
material_impl: GlassCard shell + ad-hoc glass-surface-subtle/10, glass-surface-dark/80 + glass-backdrop-blur-md suggestion dropdown (bespoke second material). No tokenised field component - raw <input>/<select> with utility classes instead of GlassInput/GlassSelect.
motion: Motion fadeIn/slideDown presets (MotionFramer reduced-motion aware). respectMotionPreference prop accepted and unused; prefersReducedMotion computed and unused.
a11y: role=search + label (good). Suggestions are not a combobox/listbox: no aria-expanded/activedescendant, no arrow-key navigation, no Escape. Clear, sort-order, view-mode, star and more buttons are icon-only without aria-label. Result rows are clickable Motion divs - not keyboard reachable. Filter labels not associated with inputs.
api: forwardRef to GlassCard. Fully uncontrolled query/filters (no value/onValueChange). `id || useA11yId()` conditional hook. Declared filter types multiselect/range/boolean are never rendered. sortBy/sortOrder/viewMode state is never applied to results.
ssr: 'use client'; window.prompt() used for saving searches.
fake_complexity: High. 'Debounced search' creates a setTimeout per keystroke and returns a cleanup from an onChange handler that React ignores - so onSearch fires for every prefix and history fills with partial queries. Saved searches are stored but never displayed. Favorite/more buttons are no-ops.
justification: One of at least six search surfaces. Most of its advertised features are broken or unwired (debounce, sort, view mode, saved searches, three of six filter types) and the suggestion list lacks combobox semantics. The certification capture shows only the card header region (ink bbox 254x74px) on a near-white page - nothing premium. Keep one search field primitive and a documented composition pattern; delete this monolith.

name: GlassAvatarGroup

name: GlassCardLink (interactive)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass with intensity/tint/depth/border/animation='float' - all discarded by OptimizedGlassCore, so the four glassVariant values (clear/frosted/tinted/luminous) render identically. Large pile of Tailwind utilities that likely don't exist in the glass utility set (perspective-1000, transform-style-preserve-3d, hover:rotate-x-1, glass-hover-scale-1-01, bg-gradient-radial).
motion: Claims '3D transform effects and physics-inspired animations'; actually CSS hover translate/scale classes. prefersReducedMotion computed, never used; respectMotionPreference unused.
a11y: Real <a href> (good) with focus classes. aria-label concatenates title+description+buttonText, overriding visible content, plus a redundant sr-only description via aria-describedby - double announcement. className duplicated literally in anchor class string.
api: forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement> but className and ...props go to the inner OptimizedGlass, not the anchor (so href-level attrs like target/rel can't be passed). onClick always preventDefault when provided - breaks cmd-click. No asChild for Next.js Link.
duplicates: src/components/card/glass-card-link.tsx (the root-exported GlassCardLink, src/index.ts:271 - different API: href/children)
justification: This file is not what consumers get: src/index.ts:271 exports a different 38-line GlassCardLink from components/card. Having two same-named components with incompatible APIs is a pure maintenance hazard. Its variant system is a no-op because the primitive discards intensity/tint. name: GlassCarousel

stories.note: Default story has no items -> renders 'No items to display'

material_impl: GlassCard shell; controls are GlassButton; dots use raw Tailwind (bg-primary, bg-white/15, border-white/30). Transition duration hard-coded 500ms in class and style regardless of animationDuration prop.
motion: CSS transform translateX transition. No reduced-motion handling for slide transition or autoplay (WCAG 2.2.2 risk).
a11y: Severe: global window keydown listener (GlassCarousel.tsx:363-390) - every carousel on the page reacts to ArrowLeft/Right and Space, and Space is preventDefault'ed globally, breaking page scroll and typing a space in any input. Arrow/play/fullscreen buttons have no aria-label; dots have no label or aria-current. No aria-roledescription='carousel', no slide labelling, no live region. Custom arrows wrapped in clickable div.
api: forwardRef. Uncontrolled only (no index/onIndexChange controlled pair). Conditional hooks: `predictive ? usePredictiveEngine() : null` etc. (GlassCarousel.tsx:183-191) - toggling those props at runtime violates Rules of Hooks and crashes. gap combined with percentage widths causes slide misalignment. Thumbnail variant: clicking a thumbnail only updates local selectedIndex and never moves the carousel.
ssr: 'use client'. Imports five 'advanced' consciousness modules (PredictiveEngine, Achievements, BiometricAdaptation, EyeTracking, SpatialAudio) - heavy and not tree-shakeable away from the core carousel.
fake_complexity: Very high. Eye tracking code is commented out ('methods may need to be implemented', GlassCarousel.tsx:448-455); predictive engine is a random-weight 'neural network simulation' (advanced/GlassPredictiveEngine.tsx:180-205); 'biometric stress level' drives autoplay speed. Six marketing variants (GlassConsciousnessCarousel etc.) are thin prop presets.
target: LiquidGlassCarouselRail rebuilt as a proper APG carousel (scroll-snap, controlled index, scoped keyboard, reduced-motion autoplay pause)
justification: The carousel hijacks global keyboard input, has unlabeled controls, breaks Rules of Hooks, and drags in a pseudo-AI 'consciousness' stack whose eye-tracking is literally commented out. The certification screenshot certified the empty state ('No items to display', ink bbox 117x13px) because the Default story passes no items. A carousel is a likely showcase surface in 5.0, so it needs a ground-up rewrite on scroll-snap with real a11y rather than polishing this.

name: GlassChat
material_impl: GlassCard shell; bubbles use raw Tailwind (bg-primary text-primary-foreground, bg-white/10, rounded-2xl, max-w-[70%]); status dots bg-green-400 etc.; participant ring border-black hard-coded. Bubbles are not glass and not tokenised.
motion: animate-slide-in-up CSS class per message with staggered delay; no reduced-motion guard at component level. scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}) on every messages change - scrolls the whole page/ancestor, not just the log.
a11y: Message list lacks role='log'/aria-live, so new messages aren't announced. Textarea has no label (placeholder only). Hover-only message actions (opacity-0 group-hover) unreachable by keyboard. Header search/call/video/more buttons have no handlers. Status dots colour-only. Uses deprecated onKeyPress (IME composition sends prematurely).
api: React.FC (no forwardRef). Conditional hook calls for six consciousness hooks (GlassChat.tsx:193-198). Emoji picker toggles state that renders nothing. Voice toggle only flips a boolean ('Voice recording logic would go here').
ssr: 'use client'. Imports the same five advanced consciousness modules as the carousel; installs a document-level click listener when consciousness=true.
fake_complexity: Very high. 'Suggested responses' and 'conversation insights' come from the random-weight predictive engine; eye-tracking code commented out (GlassChat.tsx:294-296); 'adaptive' input height driven by simulated stress level. Six variant wrappers are presets.
target: Composable Chat primitives: ChatLog(role=log) + MessageBubble + GlassChatInput composer; drop consciousness features
justification: Chat is a high-value surface for an AI-era glass system, but this is a 1,245-line monolith where half the code is simulated intelligence and many visible controls do nothing. Bubbles are flat Tailwind, not the material system. Rebuild as small composable parts (log, bubble, composer, typing indicator) with real ARIA log semantics and token-driven bubble materials.

name: GlassChatInput
material_impl: GlassCard shell; textarea uses bg-glass-fill ring-white/10 placeholder-white/50 (dark-only assumptions); emoji/format panels glass-surface-subtle/10.

name: GlassColorWheel

name: GlassComponentPlayground
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell; every button re-skinned with long inline style blocks (rgba(255,255,255,.22), rgba(148,163,184,.28)) duplicated 5x - bypasses GlassButton/GlassTabs entirely.
a11y: Tabs are plain buttons: no role=tablist/tab/tabpanel, no aria-selected, no arrow keys. Category select unlabeled. Prop labels not associated with inputs.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no style passthrough. generateCodeFromProps used inside an effect declared before it (works only due to hoisting order of renders); theme/codeTheme props unused. Code output is naive (no children, functions stringified).
fake_complexity: Low - but it is a mini-Storybook re-implementation.
justification: A component playground is documentation infrastructure; shipping it in the runtime package bloats the API and it hand-rolls tabs and buttons with inline rgba instead of using the library's own components - the opposite of dogfooding. Move to the docs app.

name: GlassDraggable
material_impl: No material at all - Motion div + raw Tailwind (shadow-2xl scale-105 rotate-2, ring-primary, border-red-500). Not glass.
motion: Intended translate follow; drop-zone transition-all. No reduced-motion handling for the rotate/scale lift.
a11y: Mouse-only: no keyboard drag (space to lift, arrows to move), no touch/pointer events, no aria-grabbed/live-region announcements, handle not focusable. GlassSortable similarly HTML5-DnD-only, which never works on touch.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef. Core bug: handleMouseDown registers the handleMouseMove/handleMouseUp from the render where isDragging===false, and both early-return on !isDragging (GlassDraggable.tsx:126-157) - the element never moves, mouseup never clears state, listeners leak, ghost stays. GlassDraggable uses mouse events while GlassDroppable reads HTML5 dataTransfer - they cannot interoperate; GlassDroppable JSON.parse(getData()) on dragover throws because data is empty/protected during dragover (:288-290). DragProvider/useDragContext unused by the components. GlassSortable/GlassDroppable/DragProvider not root-exported.
fake_complexity: High: the root-exported GlassDraggable does not actually drag.
target: dnd-kit-based GlassSortable/Draggable recipes (keyboard sensor, pointer sensor, announcements) with a glass 'lifted' material state
justification: The headline component is non-functional due to stale closures, the droppable throws on dragover, and the pieces use incompatible event models. It has no glass material and zero accessibility. Rebuild on dnd-kit (or a pointer-events + keyboard sensor implementation) and contribute only the visual lifted/drop-target states from the design system.
